## DPStyleARWebLive.startCamera() method

Start and prepare the camera module for frame capture. This method opens the camera pipeline and post-renderer resources, but it does not capture frames by itself. Actual frame capture occurs when grab() is called.

**Signature:**

```typescript
startCamera(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when the camera module is ready.
